concepts.title: 01 / 糖果波普
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity desktop application UI design concept for the existing project "Job Agent", a Chinese local job-search AI agent workbench. Wide landscape 16:10 image, flat straight-on UI screenshot, no laptop/device mockup, no perspective, no external background, polished implementable interface. Rich colors with excellent readable contrast. Render short crisp simplified Chinese UI labels. Core real functionality: left navigation 工作台, 开始投递, 岗位收藏, 投递历史, 聊天记录, 个人资料, 模型设置. Main workspace with embedded recruitment browser (visible address toolbar and recruitment page) and a right Agent Copilot panel with match analysis, execution steps and confirmation card. Top Manual / Copilot / Auto mode selector (Copilot selected), 暂停 Agent, connected indicator. Mock job content: 前端开发工程师, 星河科技, 上海 · 经验不限, 18–28K, React, TypeScript. Agent panel: 匹配度 92%, 岗位分析, 技能匹配, 待确认; editable short greeting preview and 确认沟通 button. Small task summary 发现岗位 24, 已筛选 12, 待确认 3. All data fictional sample. Clear hierarchy, generous spacing, coherent icons, careful alignment; no irrelevant analytics graphs, no promised attachment sending feature, no marketing landing page. Each screenshot should be an entire usable app, not a palette board.
Style direction: Expressive neo-brutalist pop design. Cream canvas, saturated cobalt sidebar, coral red action buttons, sunshine yellow summary cards, mint green and lilac supporting cards. Bold black typography, 2px dark outlines, restrained hard offset shadows, large rounded rectangular modules. Joyful confident graphic design, real productive app density. Browser middle and vivid copilot right. Tiny geometric decorations only.
Small concept label in the top chrome: 01 / 糖果波普
